top_choice_rationale: P001 (Kane, Mele, Molenkamp) pairs a theoretical origin, the Z2 classification and quantum spin Hall prediction, with a decisive and clean experimental fingerprint, quantised edge conductance in HgTe wells, confirmed independently for more than fifteen years. The three-person allocation follows the causal chain and keeps the joint Kane-Mele paper together; the narrow citation avoids claiming the 3D phase, and the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang gap is real but does not make the discovery immature. P002 is mature and cleanly attributed but narrower, and an award is better than none.
